# Synthetic identity-tag media

These files contain 0.1 seconds of generated digital silence and no copyrighted source audio.
They were generated once with FFmpeg 7.1.3 using `anullsrc` and the standard FLAC, libmp3lame,
AAC, libvorbis, and libopus encoders. Tests copy the committed fixtures and do not require FFmpeg,
an encoder, or network access at runtime.
